domain-information: A Product Manager defines new features and updates the platform roadmap to improve user engagement
A Product Manager analyzes user feedback and usage patterns to prioritize development efforts
A Content Moderator reviews posts and removes inappropriate content to maintain community standards
A Content Moderator flags suspicious accounts and reports them to the security team to prevent misuse
A Community Manager organizes campaigns to encourage user participation
A Community Manager responds to user inquiries and moderates discussions to foster positive interactions
A Data Analyst tracks platform metrics and generates reports to guide strategic decisions
A Data Analyst identifies trends in user behavior and shares insights with the product team to optimize features
A User contributes posts, images, and videos to share experiences and interact with the community
A User comments on other users’ content and participates in polls or campaigns to increase engagement

domain objects.name: Product Manager
domain objects.description: person responsible for defining features and steering platform direction

domain objects.name: Platform Roadmap
domain objects.description: plan outlining upcoming platform features and improvements

domain objects.name: Feature
domain objects.description: individual platform capability planned or delivered

domain objects.name: User Feedback
domain objects.description: input from users about their experience or feature needs

domain objects.name: Content Moderator
domain objects.description: person who reviews and manages platform content

domain objects.name: Post
domain objects.description: user generated content shared on the platform

domain objects.name: Comment
domain objects.description: user response or remark attached to a post

domain objects.name: Review
domain objects.description: evaluation step performed on content for compliance or quality

domain objects.name: User
domain objects.description: platform participant who creates and interacts with content

domain objects.name: User Account
domain objects.description: profile and identity container for a user

domain objects.name: Usage Data
domain objects.description: record of user actions and behavior on the platform

domain objects.name: Flag
domain objects.description: marker indicating content or accounts requiring attention

domain objects.name: Security Team
domain objects.description: group responsible for handling misuse or suspicious activity

domain objects.name: Community
domain objects.description: organized group of users and related interactions

domain objects.name: Community Manager
domain objects.description: person who manages community interactions and activities

domain objects.name: Discussion
domain objects.description: conversation thread between users

domain objects.name: Campaign
domain objects.description: organized community activity promoting engagement

domain objects.name: User Inquiry
domain objects.description: message from a user requesting help or information

domain objects.name: Data Analyst
domain objects.description: person who interprets platform metrics and user behavior

domain objects.name: Platform Report
domain objects.description: compiled data summary of platform performance

domain objects.name: Platform Metrics
domain objects.description: quantitative indicators of platform performance

Flag is attached to a User Account
